title: A — Chart workspace
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a NEW high fidelity COMPLETE BROWSER UI design concept for Dunner household monthly expense sharing. Referenced image is the accepted SHAREABLE IMAGE DESIGN, used as a visual language and chart reference, NOT an edit target. Expand it into a working app interface. No product code, just realistic UI design.
Design board landscape approx3:2, ONE large desktop web-app viewport on left (roughly75%width) and ONE narrow mobile responsive viewport on right (25%width), both fully visible, flat front-on, no photographic devices, perspective or background scene. Small variant label above outside viewports. Enough resolution and readable labels to review actual controls, hierarchy and spacing.
Accepted style invariants: modern bold geometric/grotesk SANS SERIF headings/numerals, neutral readable sans-serif body; white and very palegray canvas, darkcharcoal text. Expense colors Rent teal,Electricitygold,Waterlightblue,Internetviolet,Groceriescoral. Roommate endpoints Wen green,Jonathanlavender,Meipink. ALL SANKEY RIBBONS retain CATEGORY color all the way from total through category into every roommate; NO destination-color blending. Root TOTAL IS ON FAR LEFT, then expense category nodes, then roommates right. Use accepted card as reference for visual tone, typographic hierarchy, chart topology and change panel.
Same fictional household all screens: October2026, expenses Rent30,000 Electricity2,400 Water600 Internet1,000 Groceries6,000, totalNT$40,000; SeptembertotalNT$38,000; increase+2,000(+5.3%). Current agreed example split across all expenses Wen40%16,000 Jonathan35%14,000 Mei25%10,000. Previous share changes+800/+700/+500. Diagram represents allocated costs, NEVER paid/received amounts.
Essential app navigation/actions: household selector 'Wen’s household'; month selector October2026 with Septemberhistory; 'Create next month'; expense amount editing and 'Add expense'; roommate share editing with Equal/Custom option; chart grouping 'Group utilities'; 'Text view'; 'Preview image'; 'Download PNG' in share preview, file Backup/Import tucked into clear household/data menu; saved locally notice 'Saved in this browser'; sample reset available via menu. No login, payment processing, reminders, synchronization.
Expense editor is a compact5row list/table with category dots and actual editable NT$ amount fields; show labels and actual values. Split controls show Wen40 Jonathan35 Mei25, '100% allocated' validation. Keep current-month edit semantics clear through small label 'This month'; future defaults accessed via household settings. Existing manually tracked contributions remain reachable through a secondary 'Contributions' tab, but do NOT make payment progress the main chart.
Include share workflow within mockup: actual miniature accepted portrait share-card preview and obvious 'Preview image'/'Download PNG' action, or clear share preview panel as direction requires. Static image layout keeps totalleft,categoryribboncolors,exactamounts and change panel wording. App is editable; exported image contains no app controls.
Exact change panel wording "The increase comes from" and "A breakdown of the NT$2,000 increase"; changes Groceries+1,300(65%),Electricity+600(30%),Water+100(5%). Concise gray panel, no giant full-history comparison table. Rent/internet unchanged.
Mobile is a believable rearrangement of the SAME app style and state, not a squeezed desktop. Prefer amount editors as stackedrows and Sankey with compact labels or a visibly selectable textview. Primary actions reachable. Keep clear accessibility affordances and normal realistic button sizes. No decorative stockicons,avatars,marketingheadlines, fake bank fields, or feature clutter. This task explores whole-UI layouts around accepted share image; layout style in direction should remain consistent with accepted colors/font.

Direction A: CHART-FIRST WORKSPACE. Slim left desktop sidebar for household and monthhistory, restrained topbar with 'October2026' and primary teal 'Preview image' button. Main two-pane area: broad central chart/read-only amount summary and change panel; narrow right editor inspector titled 'Expenses' with5editable rows, Add expense, and below 'Roommate split' showing Custom40/35/25 and100%allocated. Center chart header includes total40,000/+2,000(+5.3%), Group utilities toggle and Textview. Sidebar has Create nextmonth, Contributions secondary nav and household/data menu. Include a small portrait share image thumbnail below inspector with DownloadPNG. Elegant high-utility layout, calm whitespace and fine rules, avoid dashboard tile grid. Mobile right viewport shows month,total,compactchart then accordion 'Expenses & split' expanded with editing rows and sticky Previewimage button at bottom. Emphasize chart review while editing side-by-side.
